assumptions: Twenty-nine logical coordinates serialize overlapping source intervals without estimating calendar duration.
Eight runtime actors represent supported choices; P_2 remains supplier/investigation context and no frozen-only institution is silently actorized.
Population actions are aggregate records, not unanimous individual behavior or recall participation rates.
P_5's request and P_8's incident notification are explicit constructed representation choices; neither creates completion or physical effects.
All baseline routes use one logical tick; receipt guards are structural communication assumptions.
The 2017 finding is unavailable to 2016 actors and enters Samsung memory only after P_9 publication and delivery.
Outcome expectations are descriptive; full evidence and terminal transport, not historical endpoint matching, control release.

This is a declared-event-vocabulary-exposed baseline: all public field names and each actor's complete capability menu are visible from the first coordinate, including event-specific future terms. Generated result values and actual receipt remain distinct from that vocabulary. No historically prefix-clean information claim is made.

World feasibility is enforced by mechanism domains and state preconditions. Only explicit handler information_requirements are mandatory receipt admission. Other message guards, activation windows and priorities are selected Rule policy assumptions, not backend-neutral historical or institutional laws.
